name: input-otp
useFor: Use for one-time codes from email or SMS (a login code, a vault unlock code). Set maxLength to the code's length and pattern to REGEXP_ONLY_DIGITS for numbers; split long codes into groups with InputOTPSeparator. Paste and SMS autofill fill every slot at once; onComplete fires when the code is full.
constraints: Hiding the characters of a one-time code
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): Form- Input's 40px, edge and focus
